children: Overview
US community bank's Q3 net income rose 22% yr/yr
Q3 results driven by higher net interest income and improved net interest margin
Company declared $0.03 per share quarterly dividend
Outlook
Company expects favorable net interest margin performance to continue into fourth quarter
AmeriServ says it has capacity to grow loan portfolio amid economic volatility
Company expects continued positive results from reengineered wealth management business
Result Drivers
NET INTEREST INCOME - Co said higher net interest income and improved net interest margin drove Q3 results
CREDIT LOSS PROVISION - Lower provision for credit losses contributed to improved earnings, per co
WEALTH MANAGEMENT FEES - Co said higher wealth management fees contributed to growth in non-interest revenue
